summary: Config paths are relative to the config file by default; some are relative to the working directory or playbook, and SSH keys use the current working directory.
questions: Are paths in ansible.cfg relative to the config file?
Why is my SSH key path resolved from the current directory?

answer_card.title: Relative paths in configuration
answer_card.answer_md: Config paths are relative to the **config file** by default, except where documented as relative to the current working directory or playbook. SSH keys use the **current working directory**, mirroring how the SSH tools behave.
